boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Learning Commons settings, from enclosed study areas to open social spaces that can accommodate different ways of working.

cards.title: North Glass House Study Area
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons private or group study area
cards.notes: Use the Learning Commons building guide to locate this named Glass House area, then set up for a focused solo session or a small working group.
cards.short_summary: A named private-or-group study area in the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists the North Glass House Study Area among its Learning Commons private or group study areas.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; consult the university’s linked building guide for floor-level location details.

cards.title: South Glass House Study Area
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons private or group study area
cards.notes: Navigate to the South Glass House via the Learning Commons building guide and bring a partner when your work benefits from a shared table.
cards.short_summary: A second named Glass House option for private or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists the South Glass House Study Area among its Learning Commons private or group study areas.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; consult the university’s linked building guide for floor-level location details.

cards.title: The Hearth Lounge
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons private or group study area
cards.notes: Choose the Hearth Lounge when you want a named Learning Commons setting for reading, outlining, or a low-key check-in with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A lounge included in Marywood’s private-or-group study-area list.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood identifies The Hearth Lounge as a Learning Commons private or group study area.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; consult the university’s linked building guide before heading over.

cards.title: The Alee Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons private or group study area
cards.notes: Use the Alee Study Lounge as a named base for a reading block or project planning; check the building guide for its placement first.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated study lounge in the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood identifies The Alee Study Lounge as a Learning Commons private or group study area.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; consult the university’s linked building guide for floor-level location details.

cards.title: Northwest Café Seating
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons social gathering space
cards.notes: Pick Northwest Café Seating for a more open work session, especially when you need a place to compare notes or meet collaborators between tasks.
cards.short_summary: Named café seating within the Learning Commons’ social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists Northwest Café Seating as a social gathering space in the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; use the university’s building guide to orient yourself in the facility.

cards.title: Southwest Café Seating
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons social gathering space
cards.notes: Set up at Southwest Café Seating for an open-table work block; it is one of the named social spaces in the Learning Commons.
cards.short_summary: A named café-seating area in Marywood’s Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists Southwest Café Seating as a social gathering space in the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; use the university’s building guide to orient yourself in the facility.

cards.title: The Street
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons social gathering space
cards.notes: Use The Street for a visible, communal setting when your session includes meeting classmates, reviewing a draft, or organizing next steps.
cards.short_summary: A named social gathering space that can support collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists “The Street” as a social gathering space in the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Learning Commons; use the university’s building guide to find it within the facility.

cards.title: Outdoor Café Terrace
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons social gathering space
cards.notes: Take reading or planning outdoors at the Outdoor Café Terrace when conditions permit; keep the task portable and check the weather before leaving.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor named social space attached to the Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists the Outdoor Café Terrace as a social gathering space in the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Learning Commons space; availability depends on campus access and weather conditions.

cards.title: South Lawn Amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons social gathering space
cards.notes: Bring a notebook or laptop for an outdoor reading or planning session at the South Lawn Amphitheater when the space is not in programmed use.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor amphitheater listed among Learning Commons social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood lists the South Lawn Amphitheater as a social gathering space in the Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor Learning Commons space; check weather and any campus event use before relying on it.

cards.title: Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable rooms in the Learning Commons
cards.notes: Reserve a room online with your MarywoodYou Portal ID for a group of two or more, or use an unoccupied room until a confirmed reservation arrives.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms with a documented drop-in option for current Marywood students.
cards.evidence_claim: Marywood says Learning Commons group study rooms are for current students; groups of two or more may reserve three-hour blocks, and unoccupied rooms may be used by drop-in.
cards.access_notes: Current Marywood students only. Reserve through the Library Catalog with a MarywoodYou Portal ID; drop-in users must yield to a confirmed reservation.
